column1: # The dispatch sheet: every scenario bound to its fixture and to the exact user turns.

column4: turns

column1: #   model: optional. Empty means the light default — the floor, on purpose. A row names a
#   tier when the flow is the advisor's own work and nobody would run it lower: migrating a
#   project on the cheapest model available is not a thing an owner does, so measuring it
#   there measures nothing. The rate a row produces is a claim about its tier.
#   setup: a bash command run inside the workspace before dispatch and committed, or "-".
#   turns: user messages in order, separated by " ||| ". The player sees nothing else.
# A scenario whose canonical query names a thing its fixture does not contain runs an
# adaptation in the fixture's own vocabulary; the adaptation lives here, in one place, so
# the pairing is written rather than inferred. S6, S7, N2, N23, N32, N33, N48, N53, N55
# and N60 are adaptations; every other row quotes its scenario verbatim.
